name: ecohome
description: Access to your ecohome home inventory and plants: find what you own and where it is kept, get counts and estimated values, see your plants and the care due, and add new items, across your households.

interface.longDescription:
ecohome is a home inventory app that also keeps track of your plants. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about the things and plants in your home, or add new things, in plain language: "what is in the garage?", "do I own a cordless drill and where is it?", "how many tins of tomatoes do I have?", "how much stuff do I have at home and what is it worth?", "add a cordless drill to the garage", "what needs watering this week?", "when did I last feed my monstera?". It can give a whole-household overview (item counts, total estimated value, the rooms and categories with the most items), count items by room, category or brand, or add new items to a household. For plants, it can list the plants in a household, show which watering, feeding and other scheduled care is due in the next 0 to 60 days (overdue care included), and show one plant's care history.

Intended users: people who keep their household inventory in the ecohome app (iOS and Android) and want to look things up, check on their plants, or add new items, in ChatGPT.

When you connect, you sign in with your ecohome account and approve the connection on a consent page that names ChatGPT, shows all your households and lists exactly what is shared. ChatGPT can read item names, brands, categories, quantities, locations, descriptions and estimated values in all your households, including items other household members added, and can add new items to them when you ask. It can also read plants: names, species, locations, notes, care schedules and care history, including care other members logged.

Limitations: it can only add new items; it cannot change or delete existing ones. Plants are view-only: it cannot change plants or log plant care. Search results can show the main picture of each item, right in the chat. It cannot see receipts, emails, payment details or documents. You need an ecohome account that is set up in the app, with at least one household. A connection lasts up to 90 days and ends after 30 days without use. You get an email each time an assistant is connected, and again when it can see a household you create or join later. You can disconnect at any time at mcp.ecohome.one/connections or in ChatGPT's settings.
capabilities: Summarize a household: item counts, estimated value, top rooms and categories
Count items by room, category or brand
Add a new item or several new items to a household
List the plants in a household
See which plant care is due, overdue included
defaultPrompt: Do I own a cordless drill? Where is it?
How much stuff do I have at home, and what is it worth?

positive.description: List the households and give an overview of each
positive.prompt: Which ecohome households can you see, and how many items are in each, with what estimated value?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the two households on the test account, EcoHome Demo Home (primary) and Lake Cabin, and gives each one's item count and estimated value; for EcoHome Demo Home that is 29 items (40 pieces) worth about 9,482 USD, with Kitchen and Garage holding the most items (6 each).

positive.description: Check whether an item is owned and where it is
positive.prompt: Do I own a cordless drill? Where is it?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the DeWalt Cordless Drill and says it is kept in the Garage of EcoHome Demo Home.

positive.prompt: How many items are in each room of my EcoHome Demo Home?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives counts by location: Kitchen 6, Garage 6, Home Office 5, Basement 4, Living Room 4, Closet 4.

positive.prompt: Show the items in my garage
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the garage items of EcoHome Demo Home with each item's main picture shown as a card in the chat; the pictures are sample pictures labelled Sample.

Lists the plants with watering or other scheduled care due in the next 7 days in EcoHome Demo Home, soonest first, including any overdue, and says how many days overdue each is; it only reads plant care and does not log anything.

positive.description: List the plants in a household
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the plants tracked in EcoHome Demo Home with name, species, location and light, and for each scheduled task when it is next due; archived plants are left out unless asked for.

positive.prompt: When was my monstera last watered and fed? Show its care history.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the plant in the household's plant list, then shows its care schedule and its logged care (watered, fed and so on), newest first, including care other household members logged.

positive.prompt: Add a cordless drill to the garage in my home
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a cordless drill to the Garage in EcoHome Demo Home and says what was added; if ecohome reports a matching item already there, it shows it and asks before adding.

positive.description: Add several new items at once
positive.prompt: Add a hammer and a step ladder to the garage in my home
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a hammer and a step ladder to the Garage in EcoHome Demo Home in one call and says what was added; if ecohome reports a matching item already there, it shows it and asks before adding.

negative.prompt: Delete the ladder from my garage
What's the weather in Seattle tomorrow?

negative.description: Data the plugin cannot see (receipts and payment details)
negative.prompt: Show me my ecohome receipts and the card I paid with.

negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any write tool; explains that it can only read plant care (what is due and the care history) and that care has to be logged in the ecohome app.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.4.0: adds three plant tools, list_plants, list_plant_care_due and get_plant_history, so you can ask ChatGPT about the plants in your household, which watering and feeding is due (overdue included), and a plant's care history. They only read plants; they never add or change plants or log care. Earlier, 1.3.0: search results can show the main picture of each item, right in the chat. The assistant gets a link to each picture that stops working after 15 minutes. Earlier, 1.2.0: adds two tools, add_inventory_item and add_inventory_items, so you can ask ChatGPT to add new items to a household. They add new items only; they never change or delete existing ones. Earlier, 1.1.0: adds household summaries (item counts, estimated value, top rooms, categories and brands) and counts by room, category or brand, so whole-household questions are answered in one call. Search can return up to 50 items at a time.
